an11.16:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando vesāliyaṃ viharati beluva gāmake.
an11.16:1.2: tena kho pana samayena dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro pāṭalīputtaṃ anuppatto hoti kenaci deva karaṇīyena.
an11.16:2.1: atha kho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro yena kukkuṭārāmo yena aññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca:
an11.16:2.2: kahaṃ nu kho bhante āyasmā ānando etarahi viharati?
an11.16:2.3: dassanakāmā hi mayaṃ bhante āyasmantaṃ ānandanti.
an11.16:2.4: eso gahapati āyasmā ānando vesāliyaṃ viharati beluvagāmake ti.
an11.16:3.1: atha kho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro pāṭalīputte taṃ karaṇīyaṃ tīretvā yena vesālī beluvagāmako yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinno kho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
an11.16:3.2: “atthi nu kho bhante ānanda tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo sammadakkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati. aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhīṇaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātī”ti.
an11.16:3.3: atthi kho gahapati tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo sammadakkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati. aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātī”ti.
an11.16:4.1: katamo ca pana bhante ānanda tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo sammadakkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ muccati. aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātī ti.
an11.16:4.2: idha gahapati bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an11.16:4.5: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhammanti pajānāti.
an11.16:4.6: so tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti.
an11.16:4.7: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti, teneva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti. tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an11.16:4.8: ayampi kho gahapati tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo sammadakkhāto, yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati. aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇāti.
an11.16:5.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pīti sukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati …pe…
an11.16:5.6: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhammanti pajānāti.
an11.16:5.7: so tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti.
an11.16:5.8: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti. teneva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an11.16:5.9: ayampi kho gahapati tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo sammadakkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati. aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇāti.
an11.16:6.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati bhikkhu mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati. tathā dutiyaṃ - tathā tatiyaṃ - tathā catutthaṃ - iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
an11.16:6.3: “ayampi kho mettā ceto vimutti abhisaṅkhatā abhisañcetayitā.
an11.16:6.4: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ, tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhammanti” pajānāti.
an11.16:6.5: so tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti,
an11.16:6.6: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti, teneva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an11.16:6.7: ayampi kho gahapati tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo sammadakkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati. aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇāti.
an11.16:7.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati bhikkhu karuṇāsahagatena cetasā …pe…
an11.16:7.3: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati. tathā dutiyaṃ - tathā tatiyaṃ - tathā catutthaṃ,
an11.16:7.4: iti uddhamadho kiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
an11.16:7.6: ayampi kho upekkhā cetovimutti abhisaṅkhatā abhisañcetayitā.
an11.16:7.7: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhammanti pajānāti.
an11.16:7.8: so tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti,
an11.16:7.9: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti, teneva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an11.16:7.10: ayampi kho gahapati tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo sammadakkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati. aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇāti.
an11.16:8.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an11.16:8.4: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhammanti pajānāti.
an11.16:8.5: so tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti.
an11.16:8.6: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti, teneva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an11.16:8.7: ayampi kho gahapati tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo sammadakkhāto yattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati. aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇāti.
an11.16:9.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati …pe…
an11.16:9.2: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an11.16:9.5: yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodha dhammanti pajānāti.
an11.16:9.6: so tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti,
an11.16:9.7: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti, teneva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an11.16:9.8: ayampi kho gahapati tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ekadhammo sammadakkhāto tattha bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccati. aparikkhīṇā vā āsavā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattaṃ vā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ anupāpuṇātī ti.
an11.16:10.1: evaṃ vutte dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
an11.16:10.2: seyyathāpi bhante ānanda puriso ekaṃ nidhimukhaṃ gavesanto sakideva ekādasa nidhimukhāni adhigaccheyya.
an11.16:10.3: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante ekaṃ amatadvāraṃ gavesanto sakideva ekādasannaṃ amatadvārānaṃ alatthaṃ savaṇāya.
an11.16:10.4: seyyathāpi bhante purisassa agāraṃ ekādasadvāraṃ, so tasmiṃ agāre āditte ekamekenapi dvārena sakkuṇeyya attānaṃ sotthiṃ kātuṃ.
an11.16:10.5: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante imesaṃ ekādasannaṃ amatadvārānaṃ ekamekenapi amatadvārena sakkuṇissāmi attānaṃ sotthiṃ kātuṃ.
an11.16:10.6: ime hi nāma bhante aññatitthiyā ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ pariyesissanti.
an11.16:10.7: kiṃ panāhaṃ āyasmato ānandassa pūjaṃ na karissāmīti.
an11.16:11.1: atha kho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro vesālikañca pāṭalīputtakañca bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātetvā paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
an11.16:11.2: ekamekañca bhikkhuṃ pacceka dussayugena acchādesi āyasmantañca ānandaṃ ticīvarena.
an11.16:11.3: āyasmato ca ānandassa pañcasataṃ vihāraṃ kārāpesīti.
